At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
Your role and responsibilities
At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration, combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities, are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions.
Are you an experienced project management leader with a passion for delivering complex projects and driving business performance? Then this could be the perfect next step in your career.
In this role, you will be responsible for managing ABB Marine & Ports' project management department, overseeing the successful execution of our global portfolio of crane terminal projects. Our projects are technically advanced, commercially complex, and strategically important, with values typically ranging from 40 MSEK to 1,000 MSEK. As most projects are executed internationally, you will operate in a dynamic and multicultural environment, collaborating with customers, partners, and colleagues around the world.
Your primary focus will be to ensure outstanding project execution through strong leadership, effective governance, commercial oversight, and strategic direction. You will lead a team of highly experienced project managers and play a key role in delivering business success, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence across the project portfolio.
You will report to the Operations Manager, ABB Marine & Ports and be based at our office in Västerås, Sweden.
Your main responsibilities
Lead the Project Management Department and ensure the successful execution of ABB Marine & Ports' project portfolio, on time, within scope, and within budget.
Provide leadership, guidance, and support to a team of experienced project managers responsible for complex international crane terminal projects.
Drive project governance, portfolio reviews, resource planning, risk management, and project performance across the organization.
Collaborate closely with engineering, procurement, commissioning, sales, and service functions to ensure effective project delivery.
Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and key stakeholders.
Contribute to the continued development of project management processes, operational excellence, and the long-term growth of the ABB Marine & Ports business.

Qualifications for the role
Technical Bachelor's or Master's degree within a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience.
Extensive experience as a Senior Project Manager, with a successful track record of delivering large and complex industrial, infrastructure, automation or engineering projects.
Strong project management expertise, including project governance, risk management, planning, execution, and delivery in an international environment.
Deep commercial and financial understanding.
Broad technical understanding and the ability to navigate complex engineering and project deliveries.
Previous experience in a formal people leadership or managerial role is considered a strong advantage.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken, combined with excellent communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills.

More about us
You will be part of the Ports business line within the Marine and Ports division that is specialized in advanced automation and information systems for all types of container and bulk cargo handling cranes, as well as OCR and electrical systems for container terminals. We offer an international and dynamic working environment where our business delivers advanced technology on large projects across the world in a customer oriented and highly globalized industry.

jobs.description:
System Tester – Pro Robotic R&D – Husqvarna Group
Want to help shape the future of professional robotic lawn care? Join our Pro Robotic R&D team and work hands-on with robotic mowers used in demanding professional environments.
Our team develops and maintains robotic mower solutions for customers such as football clubs, parks, commercial properties and golf courses. Reliability, efficiency and consistent performance are essential, and that is where our System Test team comes in.

As a System Tester, you will be part of the System and Test team, verifying system behaviour, functionality and overall product quality.

Role Description
This is a hands-on role where you will test our robotic products in real field environments, simulated and lab environments, as well as through automated test pipelines. You will work closely with system engineers, software and product development teams, and other test functions to understand how the complete system performs. Your responsibilities will include:
Verifying new functionality and bug fixes in field and lab environments
Performing regression and acceptance testing
Identifying, analysing and documenting deviations from requirements
Tracking test progress and ensuring coverage against requirements
Contributing to improved test methods, workflows and ways of working

The exact focus of the role can be adapted based on your previous experience, technical strengths and areas where you want to continue developing.
You will travel approximately four times per year, with each trip lasting around two weeks.

Your profile
You are curious, structured and quality-minded, with a genuine interest in understanding how technology works in practice. You enjoy combining hands-on testing with analysis and problem-solving. Furthermore, take ownership of your work, know how to prioritise and enjoy collaborating across different engineering disciplines in a dynamic R&D environment.
We believe you have:
At least 2 years of experience testing embedded products
A B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Software Development, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering or a related field
Professional proficiency in English, both spoken and written, Swedish is a plus
A Swedish B driving licence
The possibility to travel

It’s a plus if you also have experience in:
System-level test automation
Data analytics
Linux and/or ROS
Electrical load testing
Jira or Azure DevOps
ISTQB or a similar software testing certification

Location
The role is based on-site in Huskvarna, combined with travel related to testing at field locations. You will travel approximately four times per year, with each trip lasting around two weeks.
We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Your application
Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. For more questions regarding the position please contact:
Hiring Manager: Tim Hartelius Tim.Hartelius@husqvarnagroup.com. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina, Gorjana.Dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

Processing of personal data
When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice: https://privacyportal.husqvarnagroup.com/en/privacy-notice

Winning Through Culture 
We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.
Our culture is built on three core themes: 
Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference. 

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

TL;DR: We’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape Lovable’s Identity & Access Management team and own how authentication, authorization, and identity work across the existing Lovable app ecosystem and the more than one million new apps built every week. You’ll work with a talented team of engineers and designers to build open, scalable identity primitives that serve individual builders, enterprises, application users, developers, and AI agents without compromising Lovable’s simplicity.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we’re looking for
Significant experience owning technically complex products, across identity, authentication, authorization, developer platforms, or infrastructure.
A track record of setting product direction in ambiguous problem spaces, aligning teams around a clear strategy, and turning that strategy into shipped products.
Strong knowledge of modern identity systems and open standards, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, passkeys, service accounts, roles, permissions, and policy-based access control.
Technical fluency. You program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on platform architecture, APIs, data models, security boundaries, and identity protocols.
Strong product sense and systems thinking. You can prioritize across authentication, authorization, and identity needs while building simple primitives that can support enormous scale and increasingly sophisticated use cases.
Exceptional communication skills and sharp judgment. You can navigate difficult tradeoffs, explain the options and consequences clearly, and help teams reach informed decisions.
A deep appreciation for the needs of personal and enterprise users, as well as both sides of the Lovable experience: the builder configuring identity and the end user interacting with a Lovable-built app.

What you’ll do
Represent the user. Develop a deep understanding of identity needs across existing Lovable-built apps and the more than one million new apps created every week.
Own the product strategy and roadmap for authentication, authorization, and identity, making deliberate tradeoffs between immediate user needs and durable platform foundations.
Define standards-based primitives for users, organizations, agents, roles, permissions, policies, sessions, and delegated access that can scale across a vast and varied application ecosystem.
Shape a smooth identity experience for both builders configuring their apps and the people using those apps.
Partner closely with engineering to balance the needs of individual builders and enterprise organizations, preserving Lovable’s simplicity while building a foundation that can scale.
Define how AI agents and other non-human identities authenticate, receive authority, act on behalf of users, and remain understandable and controllable.
Own identity and access needs for programmatic use of Lovable across API, CLI, SDK, and MCP surfaces.
Keep it simple. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn’t.

Projects you’ll tackle first: Partner with engineering to shape and deliver a multi-tenant identity service built on open standards that supports authentication and authorization across millions of applications and provides a durable foundation for Lovable.

jobs.occupation: Data & AI Engineer to a Fast-Growing Scandinavian Brand!
jobs.description:
If you're passionate about data, code, and AI, take pride in getting the numbers right, and want to build the data and AI platform behind a fast-growing beauty brand, we'd love to hear from you. Send us your application today!
About the role
Our client is a Stockholm-based global beauty brand. They develop premium, high-performing products at accessible price points, defined by quality and a Scandinavian aesthetic. Driven by an entrepreneurial and creative culture, they combine modern brand storytelling with operational excellence.
Every decision across their organisation, from which shades to restock to which campaigns to scale or markets to expand into, starts with data. Their modern data platform unifies e-commerce, advertising, and retail metrics, while custom AI assistants empower teams to interact with that data directly.
As a Data & AI Engineer, you will join their Tech team and report directly to the CTO. You will collaborate closely with marketing, finance, and operations to build and run the pipelines, services, and AI tooling powering company-wide analytics. From modelling sales data in Dataform to deploying an MCP server that lets AI assistants query BigQuery, you will ensure stakeholders have access to reliable, documented, and timely figures.
This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career or with a couple of years of experience who writes solid SQL, values clean and well-tested code, builds with AI daily, and wants ownership of production systems at a rapidly scaling brand.
Work tasks
You will build and maintain data pipelines, models, and AI-driven services to support business reporting, analytics, and data-informed decisions across the company:
Build and maintain data models in Dataform and BigQuery (incremental models, assertions, and cost-aware partitioning/clustering).  
Ingest data from source systems (e-commerce, advertising platforms, ERP, and retail partners) into BigQuery with scheduling, alerting, and backfills.  
Write and deploy Python or TypeScript services on Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Cloud Scheduler) with proper IAM, secrets management, and logging.  
Collaborate with marketing, finance, and operations to translate ambiguous business questions into precise data models and queries.  
Build, deploy, and maintain MCP servers on Cloud Run to connect AI assistants to internal data, applying least-privilege IAM and monitoring.  
Maintain the semantic layer for AI assistants (defining metrics once, writing metadata and catalog documentation, and solving data discrepancies at the source).  
Use coding agents (e.g. Claude Code) as your default development workflow-writing clear task specs, critically reviewing outputs, and shipping tested code via CI/CD.  
Support internal teams in expanding their AI workflows and setting up custom assistants.

We are looking for
A university degree (BSc or MSc) in computer science, software engineering, data engineering, information systems or equivalent.
Up to around two years of experience in data (strong plus) or software engineering – internships, thesis work and serious side projects count.
Solid SQL – joins, window functions, data grain and incremental models.
Hands-on coding in Python or TypeScript; you can write, test and debug a small service on your own.
Exposure to a cloud platform, ideally Google Cloud.
An AI-native way of working – you use coding agents daily and know when not to trust their output.
A collaborative mindset and the ability to explain what you built, and why, to non-technical colleagues.
Curiosity, a quick learning curve and comfort in a fast-paced environment.
Fluent Swedish and English.

It is meritorious if you have
Production experience with BigQuery, and with Dataform or dbt.
Experience with dimensional modelling and data quality testing.
An understanding of containers, service accounts, least-privilege access and basic networking.
Experience in e-commerce, retail or consumer brands.
Experience building or integrating LLM-based tooling – MCP, function calling or agents. Side projects count.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Stress tolerant
Goal oriented
Orderly
Responsible
Intellectually curious

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

This is an opportunity to shape how a world-class design-led organisation develops products and produces creative content using digital tools, data and AI. You hold broad responsibility for the digital landscape within Brand & Product, with the mandate to propose improvements and investments.
The role combines strategic direction with practical implementation. You work closely with creative teams, product functions and technology specialists to establish shared ways of working. You also contribute to transparency and traceability initiatives within sourcing and sustainability.
About the role
As Head of Digital – Brand & Product, you hold strategic responsibility for the digital direction, capabilities and contribution to business performance across product development, brand and studio operations. You translate Lindex’s overall strategy into a clear digital direction, setting priorities and driving the development of digital capabilities, data, AI and technology to support sustainable growth, efficiency and long-term business success.
Working in close partnership with business and functional leaders, you ensure that digital priorities are aligned with business objectives and translated into tangible results. You lead the digital transformation and continuous development of Brand & Product, identifying opportunities to strengthen processes, enhance the creative value chain and create smarter, more connected ways of working – from initial design and prototyping to content and media production.
You lead a team and strengthen the organisation’s digital capabilities, driving AI adoption, cross-functional collaboration and new ways of working across the business area. Through strong collaboration with internal stakeholders, technology partners and peers across the organisation, you ensure that digital development supports both current business needs and future opportunities.
The Head of Digital – Brand and Product holds full accountability for the business team's digital direction, capabilities and contribution to commercial, financial, operational, sustainability and people performance. The role reports to the Chief Digital Officer (CDO).
Key responsibilities
Define the digital direction, target state and multi-year roadmap for Brand and Product.
Digitalise and improve workflows across design, product development, sourcing, sustainability and studio production.
Lead the implementation and adoption of digital tools, data solutions, automation and AI.
Evaluate and develop the application portfolio, including usage, user satisfaction, modernisation and investment needs.
Build alignment between designers, creative teams, product functions, developers and other stakeholders.
Lead a team of digital leads, developers and AI specialists, including competence and talent development.
Use business, operational and user data to prioritise initiatives and improve workflows.
Contribute to the overall digital transformation as part of the Digital & Tech Management Team, driving digital competence development, AI adoption and new ways of working across the organisation.
Drive organisational change while balancing ongoing operations, continuous improvement and new digital capabilities.
Establish strategic leadership and clear ownership of digital partners and suppliers, ensuring strong performance and alignment with business objectives.

About you
You understand how creative processes, business priorities and technology need to work together. You can engage designers and technical specialists, create clarity where ownership is shared and lead change through constructive dialogue. You challenge established ways of working while remaining attentive to the people and expertise affected by transformation.

A relevant university degree or equivalent professional experience.
Experience from fashion, apparel, retail or another design-led product environment.
Extensive experience in digital development and technology within a business context.
Leadership experience, including responsibility for teams, capabilities and priorities.
Documented experience of translating business strategy into digital roadmaps and execution.
Experience of driving organisational change, transformation and continuous improvement.
Experience with digital products, application landscapes, data, automation or AI adoption.
Strong communication skills and fluency in English.

It is advantageous if you have:
Knowledge of digital product development workflows, 3D design, visualisation or digital media production.
Experience leading across reporting lines and building trust with business and technology stakeholders.
